footnotes.flatRange: Range is a maximum distance, not an increment.
footnotes.teamIssue: Each pick issues one to every team member.
footnotes.rechargeable: Free recharge from power; a full charge takes 1/4 of battery life.
footnotes.programPower: Set each program's Power Rating when it is requested.
footnotes.noResplit: The resulting picks cannot be split again.
footnotes.activation: Switching it on or off takes a half action.
footnotes.noRecharge: No use past battery life until recharged; install twice for more.
footnotes.perChosenItem: Values follow the chosen Common Item or gear pick.
footnotes.rangeBlast: Before the slash: attack range increment. After: blast increment.
footnotes.droneRecharge: Recharges fully in 8 hours while switched off.
footnotes.grenadesExcluded: Grenades can only be unmarked with the Reputation/Net Worth version.
